vulnerability_title: [M-05] Protocol Disable Functionality Bypass Allows Critical Operations During Emergency Shutdown

recommendation.recommendation_text:
Add the `onlyActiveProtocol` modifier to all margin and collateral management functions that should be restricted during protocol shutdown.

[View detailed Proof of Concept](https://code4rena.com/audits/2025-08-gte-perps-and-launchpad/submissions/F-130)
